{{Top|leg}}
A '''shotgun hypertransceiver''' was a communications system installed aboard [[Agave-class picket ship|''Agave''-class picket ships]]. Because the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] role was to scout ahead of the main [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], it needed a communications method with minimal detection. The shotgun hypertransceiver was used for that purpose.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
